command:
Load the skill-creator skill and create a new skill.

Responsibility: Turn git commit subjects into a Keep a Changelog entry.

In-scope:
- Grouping commits by type
- Writing Added, Changed, and Fixed sections

Out-of-scope:
- Running git commands
- Committing
- Publishing

Instructions:
1. Read commit subjects from a text file
2. Group them by type
3. Print Markdown
4. Write docs/CHANGELOG.md

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Every commit appears exactly once
- [ ] Empty input prints an empty entry
- [ ] The output is valid Markdown

Rule IDs for the Rules table: R1, R2, R3
Skill ID: sandbox-demo (project-local)
